posts.text: 📦 The US Postal Service is seeking approval for an 11% fuel surcharge on domestic Priority Mail and packages from January, up from a temporary 8% set in April. It said higher fuel costs added $225m to transport costs in the year to Sept. 30. #Fuel #USPS

🦃 Hosting Thanksgiving? Work back from serving time and note when each dish must start. The Christmas Dinner Planner (Google Sheets/Excel) does that math and tracks guests, RSVPs, menu and grocery budget. https://www.etsy.com/listing/4607125058 #Thanksgiving #HolidayPlanning

🛢️ EU foreign ministers are set on Nov. 16 to sanction more Russian oil refineries and the shadow fleet ecosystem, EU Commissioner Maria Luís Albuquerque said. Over 690 shadow fleet vessels are already listed; a 22nd package is being prepared. #Russia #Oil

🛢️ Argentina threatened Rockhopper Exploration CEO Sam Moody with prosecution and jail over the Falklands Sea Lion oil project, his statement to the law of the sea tribunal shows, the Guardian reported. A ruling is due on Nov. 28. #Oil #Falklands

🛢️ Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two supertankers carrying more than 4 million barrels of oil were disabled by explosions on an "unauthorised" southern route in the Strait of Hormuz overnight. The claim has not been independently verified. #Oil #Hormuz

🔥 EU buyers paid about €8.7bn ($9.6bn) for LNG from Russia's Yamal project in January–October, over a fifth more than in all of 2025, NGO Urgewald said, citing Kpler data. A full EU ban on Russian gas imports starts in under two months. #LNG #EU

🇺🇦 Ukraine, Russia and the US resumed trilateral peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10, the first since February. Kyiv aims to discuss prisoner exchanges and a possible maritime and energy ceasefire, the Kyiv Independent reported. #Ukraine #Russia

🛢️ Trump said the Iran war could end "fairly soon" after meeting Qatar's prime minister, calling new US strikes "quite unlikely." Brent fell more than 1% to $91.56 a barrel on Tuesday, near a 10-week low, CNBC reported. #Oil #Iran

⛽ Rosneft has capped petrol sales at its stations across Russia at 30 litres in cities and 50 on highways, The Moscow Times reports, after lifting limits on Oct. 23. The curbs follow Ukrainian drone strikes on refineries, including Kirishi. #Oil #Russia

🛢️ Iran's Revolutionary Guards said two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz; Fars said a third also caught fire. The US said it disabled a vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Reuters could not confirm the reports. #Oil #Hormuz

⚡ Russian-controlled Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power on Sunday after damage disconnected the Ferosplavna line, its Russian-installed management said. Backup diesel generators are running and radiation is normal, it added. #Ukraine #Nuclear

🌍 The EU and UK are nearing a deal to relink their carbon markets, which could be announced at a Nov 20 summit, Bloomberg reports. UK December permits closed Friday at £64.81/t vs €86.55 for EU benchmarks; ABN Amro sees the gap narrowing. #Carbon #Energy

⚡ China's energy investment is projected at $940bn in 2026, the most of any country, per a report cited by CCTV. The IEA sees grid spending near $140bn. Coal fell to 49.7% of power output in H1, below 50% for the first time. #Energy #China

🛢️ The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at the kingdom, two toward Riyadh and one toward the Eastern province. The Houthis claim strikes on Aramco facilities. Gulf supply risk stays in focus. #Oil #Yemen

🛢️ Zero Russian diesel has reached the US under the Trump-Putin October deal; at least 3 US-bound tankers redirected. Congress's ban still stands despite a temporary OFAC waiver. Diesel near $6/gal. #Oil #Markets
